newsitem.title: CANADA: Molson Breweries reaches contract with drivers.
newsitem.headline: Molson Breweries reaches contract with drivers.

text.p: Molson Breweries said on Monday that it has agreed to a new contract with 75 drivers at its Etobicoke transport fleet.
The new contract includes base wage cuts of C$4.40 per hour from the current wage rate of C$23.40 per hour, the Canadian brewer said in a statement.
The contract will also use the trucking industry standard of pay by the kilometre for setting productivity standards and reducing overtime.
"Molson is very pleased to have its drivers back on the road...," said John Hay, vice-president of public affairs.
Molson Breweries is 40-percent-owned each by Molson Cos Ltd and Foster's Brewing Group Ltd, and 20 percent by Philip Morris Cos Inc's Miller Brewing unit.
Molson is also offering voluntary retirement and separation packages to workers for a two-week period.
